digest.component_or_area: agent guidance and developer tool integration
propositions: Agents prefer grep over Serena's symbol tools despite documentation because grep incurs zero extra friction while Serena requires a ToolSearch discovery round-trip
Serena's LSP-based symbol resolution cannot find symbols referenced as string literals (e.g., in monkeypatch.setattr), making it incomplete if used exclusively
Serena's index can lag behind recent edits, reporting stale line numbers while grep searches the current tree
Current guidance in AGENTS.md is stated as preference rather than division of labour, making agents discount it when exceptions apply

The three mechanisms causing the problem require structural fixes: re-surface the tool at action time via PreToolUse hook, remove friction asymmetry by disabling ToolSearch discovery, and coach agents in-band during code review when references are incompletely enumerated
